question: What's Angela Sanders's major?
golden_sql: SELECT T2.major_name FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id WHERE T1.first_name = 'Angela' AND T1.last_name = 'Sanders'

question: Among the students from the Student_Club who attended the event "Women's Soccer", how many of them want a T-shirt that's in medium size?
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.event_id) FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN member AS T3 ON T2.link_to_member = T3.member_id WHERE T1.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer' AND T3.t_shirt_size = 'Medium'

question: What is the amount of the funds that the Vice President received?
golden_sql: SELECT T2.amount FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN income AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member WHERE T1.position = 'Vice President'

question: List the full name of the Student_Club members that grew up in Illinois state.
golden_sql: SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN zip_code AS T2 ON T1.zip = T2.zip_code WHERE T2.state = 'Illinois'

question: Was each expense in October Meeting on October 8, 2019 approved?
golden_sql: SELECT T3.approved FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget WHERE T1.event_name = 'October Meeting' AND T1.event_date LIKE '2019-10-08%'

question: Calculate the total average cost that Elijah Allen spent in the events on September and October.
golden_sql: SELECT AVG(T2.cost) FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member WHERE T1.last_name = 'Allen' AND T1.first_name = 'Elijah' AND (SUBSTR(T2.expense_date, 6, 2) = '09' OR SUBSTR(T2.expense_date, 6, 2) = '10')

question: Calculate the difference of the total amount spent in all events by the Student_Club in year 2019 and 2020.
golden_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T1.event_date, 1, 4) = '2019' THEN T2.spent ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T1.event_date, 1, 4) = '2020' THEN T2.spent ELSE 0 END) AS num FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event

question: What was the notes of the fundraising on 2019/9/14?
golden_sql: SELECT notes FROM income WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received = '2019-09-14'

question: Tell the phone number of "Carlo Jacobs".
golden_sql: SELECT phone FROM member WHERE first_name = 'Carlo' AND last_name = 'Jacobs'

question: What is the status of the event which bought "Post Cards, Posters" on 2019/8/20?
golden_sql: SELECT T1.event_status FROM budget AS T1 INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.budget_id = T2.link_to_budget WHERE T2.expense_description = 'Post Cards, Posters' AND T2.expense_date = '2019-08-20'

question: What was Brent Thomason's major?
golden_sql: SELECT T2.major_name FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id WHERE T1.first_name = 'Brent' AND T1.last_name = 'Thomason'

question: For all the club members from "Business" major, how many of them wear medium size t-shirt?
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.member_id) FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id WHERE T2.major_name = 'Business' AND T1.t_shirt_size = 'Medium'

question: Which department was the President of the club in?
golden_sql: SELECT T2.department FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id WHERE T1.position = 'President'

question: State the date Connor Hilton paid his/her dues.
golden_sql: SELECT T2.date_received FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN income AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member WHERE T1.first_name = 'Connor' AND T1.last_name = 'Hilton' AND T2.source = 'Dues'

question: How many times was the budget in Advertisement for "Yearly Kickoff" meeting more than "October Meeting"?
golden_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN T1.amount ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN T1.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM budget AS T1 INNER JOIN event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id WHERE T1.category = 'Advertisement' AND T2.type = 'Meeting'

question: What is the total cost of the pizzas for all the events?
golden_sql: SELECT SUM(cost) FROM expense WHERE expense_description = 'Pizza'

question: How many cities are there in Orange County, Virginia?
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(city) FROM zip_code WHERE county = 'Orange County' AND state = 'Virginia'

question: What does the person with the phone number "809-555-3360" major in?
golden_sql: SELECT T2.major_name FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id WHERE T1.phone = '809-555-3360'

question: How many members attended the "Women's Soccer" event?
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(T2.link_to_member) FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'

question: List all the members of the "School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education" department.
golden_sql: SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id WHERE T2.department = 'School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education'

question: Among all the closed events, which event has the highest spend-to-budget ratio?
golden_sql: SELECT T2.event_name FROM budget AS T1 INNER JOIN event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id WHERE T2.status = 'Closed' ORDER BY T1.spent / NULLIF(T1.amount, 0) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: What is the highest amount of budget spend for an event?
golden_sql: SELECT MAX(spent) FROM budget

question: What is the total amount of money spent for food?
golden_sql: SELECT SUM(spent) FROM budget WHERE category = 'Food'

question: List the name of students that have attended more than 7 events.
golden_sql: SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member GROUP BY T1.member_id, T1.first_name, T1.last_name HAVING COUNT(T2.link_to_event) > 7

question: Which student has been entrusted to manage the budget for the Yearly Kickoff?
golden_sql: SELECT T4.first_name, T4.last_name FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget INNER JOIN member AS T4 ON T3.link_to_member = T4.member_id WHERE T1.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff'

question: Which event has the lowest cost?
golden_sql: SELECT T1.event_name FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget ORDER BY T3.cost NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

question: Based on the total cost for all event, what is the percentage of cost for Yearly Kickoff event?
golden_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN T3.cost ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(T3.cost), 0) FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget

question: Indicate the top source of funds received in September 2019 based on their amount.
golden_sql: SELECT source FROM income WHERE date_received BETWEEN '2019-09-01' AND '2019-09-30' ORDER BY source DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: How many members of the Student_Club have major in 'Physics Teaching'?
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(T2.member_id) FROM major AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.major_id = T2.link_to_major WHERE T1.major_name = 'Physics Teaching'

question: Name the event with the highest amount spent on advertisement.
golden_sql: SELECT T2.event_name FROM budget AS T1 INNER JOIN event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id WHERE T1.category = 'Advertisement' ORDER BY T1.spent DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

question: Did Maya Mclean attend the 'Women's Soccer' event?
golden_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN T3.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer' THEN 'YES' END AS result FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member INNER JOIN event AS T3 ON T2.link_to_event = T3.event_id WHERE T1.first_name = 'Maya' AND T1.last_name = 'Mclean'

question: Indicate the cost of posters for 'September Speaker' event.
golden_sql: SELECT T3.cost FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget WHERE T1.event_name = 'September Speaker' AND T3.expense_description = 'Posters'

question: Indicate the name of the closed event whose cost has exceeded the budget the most.
golden_sql: SELECT T2.event_name FROM budget AS T1 INNER JOIN event AS T2 ON T2.event_id = T1.link_to_event WHERE T1.event_status = 'Closed' AND T1.remaining < 0 ORDER BY T1.remaining NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

question: Identify the type of expenses and their total value approved for 'October Meeting' event.
golden_sql: SELECT T1.type, SUM(T3.cost) FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget WHERE T1.event_name = 'October Meeting' GROUP BY T1.type

question: Calculate the amount budgeted for 'April Speaker' event. List all the budgeted categories for said event in an ascending order based on their amount budgeted.
golden_sql: SELECT T2.category, SUM(T2.amount) FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.event_name = 'April Speaker' GROUP BY T2.category ORDER BY SUM(T2.amount) ASC

question: Mention the total expense used on 8/20/2019.
golden_sql: SELECT SUM(cost) FROM expense WHERE expense_date = '2019-08-20'

question: List out the full name and total cost that member id "rec4BLdZHS2Blfp4v" incurred?
golden_sql: SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, SUM(T2.cost) FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member WHERE T1.member_id = 'rec4BLdZHS2Blfp4v' GROUP BY T1.first_name, T1.last_name

question: State what kind of expenses that Sacha Harrison incurred?
golden_sql: SELECT T2.expense_description FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member WHERE T1.first_name = 'Sacha' AND T1.last_name = 'Harrison'

question: State the category of events were held at MU 215.
golden_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.category FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.location = 'MU 215'

question: List the last name of members with a major in environmental engineering and include its department and college name.
golden_sql: SELECT T2.last_name, T1.department, T1.college FROM major AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.major_id = T2.link_to_major WHERE T2.position = 'Member' AND T1.major_name = 'Environmental Engineering'

question: What are the budget category of the events located at MU 215 and a guest speaker type with a 0 budget spent?
golden_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.category, T1.type FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.location = 'MU 215' AND T2.spent = 0 AND T1.type = 'Guest Speaker'

question: Among the members with t-shirt size of medium, what is the percentage of the amount 50 received by the Student_Club?
golden_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.amount = 50 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T2.income_id), 0) FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN income AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member WHERE T1.position = 'Member' AND T1.t_shirt_size = 'Medium'

question: List the names of closed event as "game" that was closed from 3/15/2019 to 3/20/2020.
golden_sql: SELECT DISTINCT event_name FROM event WHERE type = 'Game' AND DATE(SUBSTR(event_date, 1, 10)) BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20' AND status = 'Closed'

question: Give the full name and contact number of members who had to spend more than average on each expense.
golden_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T3.first_name, T3.last_name, T3.phone FROM expense AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.link_to_budget = T2.budget_id INNER JOIN member AS T3 ON T3.member_id = T1.link_to_member WHERE T1.cost > (SELECT AVG(T1.cost) FROM expense AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.link_to_budget = T2.budget_id INNER JOIN member AS T3 ON T3.member_id = T1.link_to_member)

question: Write the full name of the member who spent money for water, veggie tray and supplies and include the cost of it.
golden_sql: SELECT T2.first_name, T2.last_name, T1.cost FROM expense AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.link_to_member = T2.member_id WHERE T1.expense_description = 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies'

question: Write the full names of students who received funds on the date of 9/9/2019 and include the amount received.
golden_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T3.first_name, T3.last_name, T4.amount FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN member AS T3 ON T3.member_id = T2.link_to_member INNER JOIN income AS T4 ON T4.link_to_member = T3.member_id WHERE T4.date_received = '2019-09-09'
